stated_limitation: which excludes high-firing-rate units that reach nominal significance from sample size alone despite negligible directional modulation

justification.dataset: Dandiset 000056 (Peyrache lab, ADn/postsubiculum) is the canonical head-direction dataset, an expert-standard choice.
justification.handling: Real streaming via remfile, valid-tracking mask (96.5% valid), longest continuous awake bout selected, LED-derived HD reconstruction all correct.
justification.analysis: Circular tuning curves with proper MVL statistic, per-unit circular-shift shuffle null, plus held-out Bayesian decoding as cross-validation is the right method done correctly.
justification.correctness: Every reported number (MVLs, p-values, 33.3 deg decoding error, 4 HD cells) reproduces exactly from the committed code and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: Polar curves, MVL bar chart, raster, and decoding are all labeled with units and sample sizes and clearly show the effect, with the classified cells honestly the strongest by MVL.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and nothing is misrepresented, but there is no explicit statement of single-session/single-animal limitations and unit 5 is called 'sharp, unimodal' when it is the weakest and noisiest of the four.
justification.verdict: A methodologically sound, reproducible demonstration of head-direction tuning with cross-validated decoding that I would accept from a rotation student.
